summary: Before 2020 the phrase appeared sporadically in education, second-language vocabulary research and neuroscience, meaning learning words or skills from surrounding context or authentic situations. Since about 2021 it overwhelmingly names the ability of large pretrained models, first GPT-3-style language models and later vision, speech, tabular and multimodal models, to perform a new task from examples placed in the prompt without updating their parameters.
